core_meaning.primary_meaning: Saadet corresponds to the Arabic form سَعَادَت and is glossed in this record as “Happiness, felicity.” The record associates the form with root س ع د (s-ʿ-d). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Saadet corresponds to the Arabic form سَعَادَت (Arabic root س ع د (s-ʿ-d); سَعَادَة (Saʿāda)). Its core sense is saadet; happiness, felicity (turkish form). Saadet is the Turkish form of Arabic سَعَادَة (Saʿāda), meaning 'happiness, felicity'.

persian.name: سعادت
